title: SnO2 quantum dot decoration of CuO nanoparticles with enhanced NO2 and H2 gas sensing response via p–n heterojunction interfaces
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38750-38761
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05533D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Valentina Paolucci, Thirugnanam Natarajan, Vittorio Ricci, Fabiola Ferrante, Carlo Cantalini
A novel SnO2-QDs/CuO nanocomposite, with CuO as base and SnO2 as modifier, is used for NO2 (20 ppb to 1 ppm) and H2 (10–250 ppm) sensing at 100 °C. The presence of p–n heterojunctions facilitates charge transfer and increases sensitivity.
